name: mechanicus_cog
notes: Half cog (left) fused with skull (right). Tooth count is diagnostic — Flux freely multiplies cog teeth. Mirror policy is true because the cog/skull arrangement is deliberately asymmetric and a mirrored version is its own valid Mechanicus variant (left-handed cog). Threshold 0.82 (slightly relaxed from 0.85) accommodates the rotation/mirror permutations.
